question: The Mahabodhi Temple Complex has direct association with the life of the ______.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Lord Buddha.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Mahabodhi Temple Complex** is a **Buddhist temple** located in** Bodh Gaya, Bihar, India**, which is believed to be the site where Lord Buddha attained **enlightenment.**
 
• The temple complex is a **UNESCO World Heritage Site** and is considered one of the holiest sites for Buddhists around the world.
 
• The temple complex has a** 50m high pyramidal spire** and houses a large gilded statue of **Lord Buddha** in a state of meditation.
 
• The temple complex has undergone several renovations and restorations over the years, with the most recent being in **2013, **which was funded by the **Government of India** and the **Archaeological Survey of India.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Jain Trithankars:**

 
 
• Jainism is an ancient Indian religion that emphasizes** non-violence and asceticism.**
 
• Trithankars are highly revered spiritual leaders in** Jainism.**
 
 
 
• **Mughal rulers:**
 
 
• The Mughal Empire was a** Muslim dynasty **that ruled over India from the **early 16th to the mid-19th century.**
 
• They were known for their **architectural achievements,** including the **Taj Mahal. **
 
 
 
• **Sikh Gurus:**
 
 
• Sikhism is a** monotheistic religion **founded in the** 15th century **by Guru Nanak.
 
• The religion has **10 gurus**, with **Guru Gobind Singh** being the last one.
